personality_one_liner: A high-trust, highly legible doorstep service platform that feels as native, reliable, and frictionless as iOS itself.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and list items must have generous inner padding (lg or xl). No cramped dashboard feeling.

do's: Use frosted glass overlays on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use for the bottom tab bar when content scrolls beneath
Apply to pinned CTA blocks (like "Book Now") that stay fixed at the bottom above safe area
dont's: Do not apply glassmorphism to form fields or body text regions
Do not apply to generic list rows
Ensure bottom tint opacity is ≥70% behind text on hero images

screens.name: Customer Home
screens.purpose: A dual-entry home screen that builds immediate trust, allowing users to browse service categories or rebook recent services quickly.

states.loading: Skeleton UI matching the category grid and featured service cards.
states.empty: Illustration of a spotless home with a prompt to explore services.
states.error: Failed to load services. 'Retry' button in brandPrimary.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header (Greeting + Location). A hero/banner card at the top displaying a high-quality lifestyle image with a gradient-to-dark scrim. Below: Horizontal scroll row for category chips (AC, Plumbing, Cleaning). Below that: 2-column grid of popular services with ratings and starting prices. Prices use Space Grotesk.

screens.name: Service Catalogue & Provider List
screens.purpose: Displays a filtered list of specific services (e.g., all AC Repair types) or available providers with transparent pricing and verified badges.

states.loading: List item skeletons with placeholder avatar circles.
states.empty: No providers available in your area right now.

screens.layout: Vertical list view. Each card contains a provider/service image on the left, Name/Title, Star Rating, Verified Badge, and Price on the right. 'Book' CTA on the card. Deep padding inside cards.

screens.name: Booking Flow (Multi-step Bottom Sheet)
screens.purpose: A frictionless 3-step funnel for finalizing the job: Select Service -> Date/Time & Address -> Payment.

states.error: Payment failed or slot unavailable. Highlight step in red.

screens.layout: Uses @gorhom/bottom-sheet for the entire flow so context isn't lost. Step 1: Address selection. Step 2: Date/Time pills. Step 3: Payment method (Cash or UPI). Sticky 'Proceed' CTA pinned to the bottom of the sheet with glass backdrop.

screens.name: Booking Status Tracker
screens.purpose: A live-tracking timeline keeping the customer informed of the provider's exact status.
screens.layout: Vertical stepper/timeline layout. (Pending -> Accepted -> On-the-way -> In-progress -> Completed). Active step highlighted in brandPrimary. Include provider profile card (with real photo, name, rating, and call/chat icons) floating at the bottom with a glass effect.

screens.name: Provider Dashboard
screens.purpose: Command center for service professionals to accept jobs and view daily earnings.

states.empty: Illustration of a relaxing provider: 'No assigned jobs today'.

screens.layout: Top section: High-contrast metric cards (Today's Earnings, Pending Jobs). Below: Vertical list of 'New Requests' and 'Active Jobs'. Each job card shows map pin, customer name, service type, and prominent 'Accept'/'Update Status' buttons.

screens.name: Admin/Owner Dashboard
screens.purpose: Mobile-first operational overview of the marketplace (revenue, provider performance, service CRUD).

states.empty: No data for this time period.

screens.layout: Grid of KPI cards (Total Revenue, Active Bookings, Registered Providers) with Space Grotesk for metrics. Horizontal scroll for 'Recent Payouts'. List of 'Action Needed' items (e.g., unresolved complaints or provider approvals).

hero_ac_repair.alt: Close up of a professional repairing an AC unit with power tools.

hero_electrical_plumbing.alt: A variety of professional maintenance tools neatly organized on a table.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality with the provided Forest Green botanical palette. Ensure all blues and purples are eradicated from the codebase.
Implement the UI with deep, generous padding inside cards (lg or xl spacing). Avoid dense, dashboard-like clustering.
For the Customer Booking flow, use `@gorhom/bottom-sheet` and create a multi-step experience rather than jumping between full pages. Keep the primary CTA pinned over a glass background.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text and 'Space Grotesk' exclusively for numerical values like prices, ratings, and dashboard KPIs. Fallback to system fonts only if loading fails.
Always apply a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to >70% surfaceInverse) behind any text overlaying hero images to guarantee WCAG contrast compliance.
Utilize haptics selectively: 'medium' on primary button taps and 'success' on booking confirmation.
Render the booking status timeline as a vertical stepper. Clearly distinguish the active state from pending states using 'brandPrimary'.
